The text 'BIC' is visible but appears slightly distorted and warped around the curvature of the object. The letters are recognizable but lack the crisp edge definition of real printed plastic, showing slight bleeding into the metallic texture.

The metallic reflection is inconsistent. Some areas show sharp specular highlights while adjacent areas appear matte or smudged without a clear light source logic, suggesting AI-generated texture synthesis errors.
